title: Yoisaki Kanade — Flowerbed of Memories〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Kanade's Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't expect Mafuyu to smile the way she did.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I may not have been able to save her this time but...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I've finally made some progress.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have Mizuki to thank for that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wanting someone to smile...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I never thought that I could make someone feel that way...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Since I'm the one that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...
Yoisaki Household - Kitchen

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Thank you for being so patient.
Here you are.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
This smells nice. Are these lychees...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes! I thought that a fruit-flavored tea would help you relax and refresh you a little.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is. The aroma and flavor both have this calming effect.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I originally planned on having her cook and clean just once a week...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But now, it's like having tea with her is a normal part of my routine.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: This feels so nice...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, I almost forgot...
I brought some more flowers today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. These have a fairly unique shape to them. See?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. That's really interesting. They look like upside-down grapes.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, they're even called grape hyacinths. Each of these bulbs are actually its flowers.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: In European cultures, blue flowers like these tend to be associated with negative symbols, such as despair or loss...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But some also say that beyond that despair or loss is a bright future because there's nowhere else to go but up from there.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Beyond that despair or loss...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. Also, there's one more thing...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They symbolize a connection with others.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: A connection with others.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, you mentioned the other day that there's someone that's been concerning you. That you'd like to know what they're feeling.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I can't believe you put so much thought into this just for me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't know what to say. I didn't mean to make you do all this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: No, I did this because I wanted to.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: All I did was ask an old friend for some advice, so it was no trouble for me, really.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, the one who knows a lot about flowers...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. When I asked her about the kind of symbolism I was looking for, she immediately started telling me about these flowers.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow. She's so knowledgeable.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Would you mind thanking her for me when you can? I really like what she's chosen for us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Yes, of course. I'll make sure to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, please feel free to ask me to do more. I'd like to help in any way I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you.
I appreciate the offer but you're already doing plenty for me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (At first, I started using a homemaker service because grandma asked me to...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I'm glad that you ended up being the person they chose for me, Ms. Mochizuki.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad that I was chosen to look after your house too, Ms. Yoisaki.
